_doc: Work-Tree schema reference. Two structures: index.json (tree root) and node files (nodes/<id>.json).

index.json.project: XX市智慧城市信息化项目

node.json (nodes/<id>.json).tender_text: 核心交换机上行带宽不低于10Gbps，需提供产品截图证明#
node.json (nodes/<id>.json).tender_location: 招标文件.pdf p.34 第3.1.3条

index.json.tender_file: Relative path to the tender file in refs/
index.json.phase: Current phase: 需求分析 | 材料搜集 | 技术标撰写 | 商务标撰写 | 质量检查
index.json.summary: Aggregate counts by status, must stay in sync with children
index.json.current_focus: ID of the node currently being worked on, null if none

children[].title: Short title summarizing the requirement
children[].priority: star (★=废标) | hash (#=需截图) | dot (●=需演示) | triangle (▲=核心产品) | normal
children[].materials: Optional: { collected: N, total: M } progress of material collection
children[].node_ref: Relative path to the node detail file

node.json.id: Must match the id in index.json children
node.json.tender_location: File + page + clause reference for traceability
node.json.priority: Same as in index.json child entry
node.json.scoring: Scoring mechanism: 逐项扣减型 or 档次评分型, with details

materials[].name: Descriptive name of the material
materials[].source: Relative path to materials/<id>-<name>.md, null if not yet collected
materials[].key_facts: Optional: key facts extracted from the material
materials[].search_scope: Optional: directories to search for this material

response.draft: Draft response text, null if not yet written
response.deviation: 正偏离 | 无偏离 | 负偏离, null if not yet determined
